annotations.title: Check a coordinate and name its format

description: Is this text a valid coordinate, and in which format (MGRS, UTM, Plus Code, Maidenhead...)? Gives the normalized form and the point. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

inputFormat.description: Skip auto-detection: latlon (dd/dms/ddm), utm, ups, mgrs, pluscode, geohash, maidenhead.

order.description: For letterless numbers: latlon (default) or lonlat. Hemisphere letters and lat/lon labels win.

ref.description: Reference point for short plus codes (in the input, and to add a short code to the output), like "40.4,-79.9".

name: identify_coordinate
title: Check a coordinate and name its format
